newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber edges up on fresh enquiries.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber edges up on fresh enquiries.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices edged higher in late trading on Monday as sentiment seen firming up following fresh foreign enquiries from Singapore and the United States, dealers said.

Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices edged higher by 0.25-0.50 cents/lb to 55.25-55.75 fob Medan, 55.00-55.50 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang as well as 54.50-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"Some foreign firms have already increased their biddings by 0.25-0.50 cents, but we still prefer to stay on the sidelines as prices are seen on the upward," one Medan dealer said.
Dealers said they expected SIR3CV to rise to around 145 cents/kb from the current 142 due to the expected higher demand. It was previously traded at 141 cents.
